externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.name: XboxEmulationHub/uwp-dep
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.role: Candidate local-only provider bundle for Dawn/WebGPU, nod, libpng, zlib, dxcompiler/dxil and libuwp. Do not vendor its binaries into this repository.
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.verificationStatus: Metadata, layout, bundled component licence texts, selected SHA-256 hashes and PE import names inspected on 2026-11-04. Still requires the Phase 2 Windows link/API verification before use.
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.layout: CMakeLists.txt defines only IMPORTED target LIBUWP; x64/include, x64/lib and x64/bin contain the prebuilts; lic/ contains Dawn, DXIL/DXC, libuwp, nod and SDL licence texts. The repository itself has no top-level licence detected by GitHub.
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.rejectedForSdl: At this commit the SDL headers are 3.4.10, but x64/bin/SDL3.dll imports MSVCP140.dll, VCRUNTIME140.dll, VCRUNTIME140_1.dll and vccorlib140.dll without the _APP suffix (SHA-256 ffd331796ecd54de8461bf5cafe442e686d9d58b0a54c431a04986c90f66a7d7). Treat that SDL as the desktop build the recipe warns about; do not link or package it.

externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.name: XboxEmulationHub/uwp-dep (separate SDL checkout)
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.relationship: Parent of uwp-dep-main commit 6ba4aad18b0f149151784f31fd339225544e24f2. The recipe links and packages SDL from a separate uwp-dep-sdl folder and identifies this commit as the true-UWP SDL source.
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.verificationStatus: PE import names and SHA-256 hashes inspected on 2026-11-04. x64/bin/SDL3.dll imports MSVCP140_APP.dll, VCRUNTIME140_APP.dll, VCRUNTIME140_1_APP.dll and vccorlib140_app.dll. Still requires the Phase 2 Windows link/API verification before use.

externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.name: worleydl/uwp-dep
externalPrebuiltsToVerifyBeforeUse.status: Credited by the recipe for UWP dependency builds, and libuwp's bundled licence names Daniel Worley. The exact commits used by the recipe are now pinned in the two XboxEmulationHub/uwp-dep entries above, so do not substitute an arbitrary worleydl branch without re-verifying imports and hashes.

phase1PcBaseline.whyThisOrder: runtime/CMakeLists.txt requires generated/build_shards/shards.cmake. Only the translator steps in rebuild-all.ps1 create it, so configure-native.ps1 must not be run first on a clean tree.
phase1PcBaseline.manualGate: PC title screen -> World 1-1 -> save -> exit/relaunch -> save persists. The runner cannot verify gameplay.

verifiedPhase0Facts: git apply --check of that patch against NSMBW v0.3.1 aurora-main fails; no files were modified by the check.

The same patch also fails against WiiCompiled v0.2.31 and the inspected current WiiCompiled Aurora submodule, so its exact preimage is another Aurora snapshot. Treat it as a semantic specification, not a drop-in patch.
NSMBW's Aurora is much closer to WiiCompiled v0.2.31 (69 differing paths) than to current WiiCompiled Aurora (293 differing paths).
NSMBW runtime already separates RuntimeMain(argc, argv) from main(), which is the right seam for a future WinRT/SDL entry shim.
On 2026-11-04 the user confirmed the exact USA SMNE01 revision 1 input, a Series S in Developer Mode, and a Windows PC with Visual Studio 2022.
A clean-tree PC build must generate translator shards before CMake configure; tools/run-phase1-pc.ps1 encodes upstream's unpack -> prelink -> rebuild-all order.
The recipe's main uwp-dep pin 6ba4aad1 contains a desktop-linked SDL3.dll by PE imports; its parent ae39aa00 contains the separate _APP-linked SDL3.dll the recipe actually links/packages.
